QuestionStmt.S: An observer on sea-coast counts 45 waves in one minute. If the wavelength of the waves is 7 m, then the velocity of the waves will be

Solution.S:
Number of waves counted in 1 minute = 45.

Time = 60 s, so frequency:

$$f = \frac{45}{60} = 0.75 \text{ Hz}$$

Wavelength $\lambda = 7$ m.

Velocity $v = f \lambda = 0.75 \times 7 = 5.25$ m/s.

Thus the correct option is B: 5.25 m/s.
